lesson.coverTitle: 7 ways to say you didn't understand
lesson.topic: 7 ways to say you didn't understand

yt.intro: Today, we will watch another video produced by Gavin, from the Youtube Channel @SmallAdvantages. Gavin is an American who teaches English to Brazilians online. Today, we'll take a look at his video on how to say that you don't understand something.

video.nome: 7 maneiras de falar NÃO ENTENDI em inglês | Dica #13

conversa: How often do you misunderstand people in English?
Do you think people understand your English?
Are there accents in Portuguese language?
Do you understand Brazilians with different accents?
Do you prefer the British accent or the American accent in English?

itens: What'd you say? [= What did you say?]

avaliacao: When you don't understand something, do you say "What'd you say?" for example or do you pretend that everything is OK?
